tip: Lhe is the indirect object pronoun, to him or to her. Eu lhe dei o recado = I gave the message to him or her.
In passive voice the participle agrees with the subject. Casa is feminine, so it is reformada, not reformado.
In the passive, the agent that did the action follows por. A conta foi paga pela empresa = the bill was paid by the company.
Before an infinitive, é proibido stays invariable: é proibido fumar. It agrees only when a noun follows, as in proibida a entrada.
Tampouco means not either, the negative of também. Tampouco ele sabia = he did not know either. It is a touch more formal than também não.
For an unreal present situation, use se plus imperfect subjunctive then the conditional: se ele não fosse orgulhoso, pediria desculpas.
Embora, meaning although, always takes the subjunctive: embora esteja frio, never embora está frio.
